label: Visual learning
title: From vertebra segmentation to fracture classification
paper: A Two-Stage Approach for the Identification and Classification of Osteoporotic Vertebral Compression Fractures
authors: Yilin Wang*, Siyu Chen*, Hongwei Zhuang*, et al.
alt: Two-stage framework connecting enhanced DeepLabv3+ vertebral segmentation and fracture classification.
description: A two-stage X-ray pipeline separates vertebral segmentation from fracture classification, supporting both fracture identification and differentiation of new and old fractures.
contribution: Developed an enhanced DeepLabv3+ segmentation module and a downstream classification pipeline for binary and three-class tasks.
result: Binary AP 72.90 and three-class AP 50.16, compared with 53.51 and 39.59 for single-stage baselines.

label: Visual learning
title: VerteX-ID: multi-task fracture detection
paper: VerteX-ID: A Multi-Task Learning Framework for Osteoporotic Compression Fracture Detection
venue: IISE Transactions on Healthcare Systems Engineering
authors: Yilin Wang*, Siyu Chen*, Hongwei Zhuang*, et al.
alt: Overview of the VerteX-ID multi-task framework with image enhancement and vertebral analysis.
description: A multi-task learning framework for osteoporotic compression fracture detection, combining image enhancement and dedicated segmentation and classification components.
contribution: Co-first-author research on learning from vertebral X-rays, with the ConDSeg and SCTNet architectures shown in the accompanying project figures.

label: Interpretable prediction
title: Interpretable preoperative DVT risk stratification
paper: An interpretable machine learning framework for preoperative deep vein thrombosis risk stratification based on thrombus size in fracture patients
alt: DVT study workflow showing risk groups, feature selection, machine learning, and SHAP interpretation.
description: A three-level risk stratification framework based on thrombus size, using 62 clinical variables from 1,216 fracture patients.
contribution: Combined LASSO feature selection, CatBoost, SMOTE, and SHAP analysis to connect predictive performance with clinical interpretation.
result: Reported test performance: 96.67% accuracy, 96.67% F1-score, and 98.94% AUC-ROC using 41 selected features.

label: Visual learning
title: Transfer learning with limited, low-quality X-rays
paper: Identifying acute thoracolumbar vertebral compression fractures from low-quality small-sample X-ray images: a transfer learning-based approach
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
authors: Yilin Wang*, Weijun Li*, Siyu Chen*, et al.
alt: Graphical abstract of the transfer learning pipeline integrating X-ray features, ViTDet, and Faster R-CNN.
description: Investigating acute thoracolumbar vertebral compression fracture identification under small-sample and low-image-quality constraints.
contribution: Integrated edge and texture features with ViTDet and Faster R-CNN to study transfer learning in a challenging clinical imaging setting.
result: Approximately 33% of acute fracture images correctly classified by the model versus 27% in manual classification in the reported experiment.

label: Signal representations
title: Listening to xylem cavitation with U-MFCC
paper: Waveform purification of ultrasonic signals from xylem cavitation in tree species based on U-MFCC feature extraction and voiceprint recognition models
alt: U-MFCC feature extraction with adapted Mel filters, IDCT, feature ranking, and PCA.
description: Adapting voiceprint recognition methods to purify ultrasonic cavitation waveforms collected from two tree species.
contribution: Developed U-MFCC with adapted Mel filter banks, IDCT, F-ratio feature selection, and PCA; evaluated ECAPA-TDNN, CAM++, and ERes2Net.
result: The workflow selects 100 feature dimensions and reduces them to 40 with PCA for downstream waveform recognition.

label: Visual learning
title: Seeing internal seed cracks without destruction
paper: Soft X-ray image recognition and classification of maize seed cracks based on image enhancement and optimized YOLOv8 model
alt: Optimized YOLOv8 architecture for recognizing internal cracks in maize seeds.
description: Non-destructive inspection of internal cracks in Zhengdan 958 maize seeds using soft X-ray imaging and an optimized YOLOv8 model.
contribution: Combined wavelet denoising, image standardization, bilateral filtering, and Laplacian sharpening with object detection.
